title: Download Data Layout
applicability: Applies to Data Segment No. DL7 (Supplemental Terminal Data Segment) used for terminal download/configuration messages, not the standard Segment 100 financial request/response flow.

businessRequirements.title: Site Language Table ID 001 shall carry a fixed three-digit Table Length of 003 and an ISO 639-2 language code associated with the terminal.
Postal Code Table ID 002 shall carry a fixed three-digit Table Length of 013 and the 13-character international postal code associated with the transmitting device.

testCases.positive: Valid Table ID, length, and data for site language and postal code

testDataStatus: No dedicated Download Data Segment (DL7) AI artifact or approved terminal-configuration fixture is currently available.
remaining: Obtain full DL7 Supplemental Terminal Data Segment layout beyond Table IDs 001/002.
